lines.zh: 翅膀扇出一层淡紫的雾
lines.en: My wings shake loose a violet haze.

lines.zh: 我在巨花之间绕着圈飞
lines.en: I circle between the giant blooms.

lines.zh: 顺着蓝色花瓣的气流滑行
lines.en: I glide on the blue petals' updraft.
My trail is gauze torn by wind.
I skim low over the flower's heart.

lines.zh: 我不是蜂，却学着嗡嗡叫
lines.en: I am no bee, yet I buzz like one.

lines.zh: 光从我的翅膜里漏出来
lines.en: Light leaks through the film of my wings.
I fly slowly; the blooms are too sweet.

lines.zh: 每一次振翅都掉下荧光
lines.en: Every wingbeat sheds a fleck of glow.

lines.zh: 蔚蓝森林的风托着我走
lines.en: The azure forest's wind carries me along.

lines.zh: 我沿着水晶峭壁的边缘巡游
lines.en: I patrol the rim of the crystal cliffs.

lines.zh: 蝶与蜂之间，我谁也不像
lines.en: Between moth and bee, I resemble neither.

lines.zh: 在花瓣上停一停又走了
lines.en: I rest on a petal, then move on.

lines.zh: 翅声细得像有人在耳边叹气
lines.en: My wings whine like a sigh at your ear.

lines.zh: 我避开末地塔投下的长影
lines.en: I keep clear of the End tower's long shadow.

lines.zh: 穿过花丛时总蹭一身花粉
lines.en: Crossing the blooms, I gather pollen everywhere.

lines.zh: 悬在半空，翅膀几乎不响
lines.en: Hanging still, my wings barely whisper.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收成一小片光
lines.en: I fold my wings into a sliver of light.

lines.zh: 就这么停在花影里发呆
lines.en: I just daze inside the flower's shade.

lines.zh: 谁在看我？我装作没发现
lines.en: Someone watching? I pretend not to notice.
My compound eyes are full of blue blooms.

lines.zh: 一动不动，像一粒会呼吸的尘
lines.en: Still as a breathing mote of dust.

lines.zh: 我数着峭壁上新长的水晶
lines.en: I count new crystals on the cliff.

lines.zh: 翅尖在微风里轻轻发抖
lines.en: My wingtips tremble in the faint breeze.

lines.zh: 这片花海安静得让我发困
lines.en: This bloom sea is quiet enough to make me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我在等一朵花慢慢张开
lines.en: I wait for one flower to slowly open.
The glow on me brightens and dims.
Easy there, let me rest a moment.
Your face is blocking my flower.
I drift behind you to look.
You don't look like you belong to the End.
Standing so close, you'd frighten the blooms.

lines.zh: 我停在你鼻尖前一点点
lines.en: I hover just short of your nose.
Your eyes are chasing my glow.

lines.zh: 我有点好奇，又有点想跑
lines.en: Curious, and a little ready to flee.
Don't reach out; my wing film is thin.
I've circled your shoulder three times.
Have you come for the flowers?
My wings are hurt.
You've pressed me to the ground.
I can no longer fly steady.
The glow on me has gone dark.
Not the wings, please.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也下得去手
lines.en: I'm this small, and you still hit me.
You shook the blossoms loose.
I'll back off, I'm backing off.
The pain jumbles my wingbeat.
Let me hide inside the bloom.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西不是花蜜
lines.en: What you hold is not nectar.

lines.zh: 让我闻闻，不对，不是这个
lines.en: Let me smell it. No, not that.

lines.zh: 我凑近了一点，只是想看看
lines.en: I came closer only to look.

lines.zh: 如果那是花，我早扑上去了
lines.en: If that were a flower, I'd have dived already.
Your waving makes my eyes swim.
I hang in the air, torn both ways.
That smell is entirely new to me.
I only know the scent of giant blooms.
Don't tease me; I might believe it.
Just one more step closer.
Oof, I bumped your shoulder.
The knock scrambled my wings.
Move aside, I can't brake.
You're too solid and I'm too light.

lines.zh: 我只想从你旁边擦过去
lines.en: I only meant to slip past you.

lines.zh: 撞完还得重新理一遍翅
lines.en: Now I must smooth my wings again.
A little bump is nothing.
You knocked the pollen right off me.
Dizzy for a moment, then fine.
Next time I'll keep my distance.

lines.zh: 和我跳一段空中圆舞吧
lines.en: Dance a midair round with me.

lines.zh: 我们的光要对着才好看
lines.en: Our glows only look right facing each other.
Keep your wings off mine, take it slow.

lines.zh: 花下那圈亮是我们留的
lines.en: That bright ring under the bloom is ours.
You fly steadier than I do.
Let's loop the giant flower three times.

lines.zh: 这是我一生最亮的时候
lines.en: This is the brightest I will ever be.
Wait; listen to my wings first.

lines.zh: 我们的尾迹缠在一起了
lines.en: Our trails have tangled together.
Don't leave me before the light comes.
Are you taking me with you?
I settle in your palm, weightless.
Don't squeeze; my wings crush at a touch.

lines.zh: 我就待一会儿，还得回花那边
lines.en: Only a moment; I must get back to the blooms.

lines.zh: 你的手比我见过的石头暖
lines.en: Your hand is warmer than any stone here.

lines.zh: 我身上的荧光沾到你了
lines.en: My glow has rubbed off on you.
Hold steady, I don't like swaying.

lines.zh: 可以，但你要带我回蔚蓝森林
lines.en: Fine, but take me back to the azure forest.

lines.zh: 你的手上有别处的味道
lines.en: Your hand smells of somewhere else.
Set me down; the wind is calling me.
Who touched this flowerbed?
My sting is small, but I will use it.
You stepped on my flower.
You then. Hold still.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经盯上你了
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on you.
The flower's heart is broken; you won't be leaving either.

lines.zh: 我要把你赶出这片花海
lines.en: I'll drive you out of this bloom sea.
Hear my wings change pitch?
Come and try my little sting.
Here I come, diving.
I'm circling overhead; don't look up.
You move, I move.

lines.zh: 我压低翅，跟着你的影子
lines.en: I lower my wings and trace your shadow.
Retreat where you like, I'm already there.
My glow will blur your sight.
Don't turn around; it won't help.
I wait for the instant you lose focus.
I circle lower with every pass.
It's quick, and hardly hurts.

lines.zh: 你身后的花都在替我看着
lines.en: Every bloom behind you watches for me.
Taste my little stinger.
Stung you, now back off!
One jab is all you'll need to remember.
I go for your eyes!
That one was for the flowers.
Don't blame me; you came close first.
Even if my stinger snaps, so be it.
Touch the blooms again and I sting again.
Does it hurt? Then step back.
I'm quicker than your dodging.
The bloom opened, and out I came.

lines.zh: 我从花瓣的缝里挤出来
lines.en: I squeeze out from between the petals.
The End's wind woke me.

lines.zh: 又一片蔚蓝森林有了嗡鸣
lines.en: Another azure forest has its hum.
I shake my wings and the light comes on.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次看见巨花
lines.en: First time I've seen the giant blooms.

lines.zh: 空气里有花粉和水晶的味道
lines.en: The air tastes of pollen and crystal.
Here I am, ever so light.

lines.zh: 从今天起这片花归我巡
lines.en: From today this patch is mine to patrol.
Don't mistake me for a speck.

lines.zh: 翅膜一碰火就卷起来了
lines.en: My wing film curls at the first flame.

lines.zh: 从这么高掉下来，光都散了
lines.en: Dropped from this height, my glow scatters.
Water is too heavy; I can't lift off.
The blast flipped my wings over.

lines.zh: 那根东西穿过了我的翅
lines.en: That thing went straight through my wing.
The spell makes my glow flicker wild.

lines.zh: 花都谢了，我快没力气了
lines.en: The blooms faded; I'm losing strength.
The lightning is far brighter than me.
The void is pulling me down.
